This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here. Consider a yarrow as the anchor of the cost.
